sources.name: Ayuntamiento de Elche radial service directory for R9 and R12 route identity and scope
Current AliBus ordered R9 and R12 stop pages with municipal stop codes and map-link coordinates
Uploaded municipal-style route diagram for R9
Uploaded municipal-style route diagram for R12
All accepted Elche scenario packages in the airport baseline, used for complete-object-exact StopNode and StopPlace reuse

transformations.description: Combines the current R9 Ida and Vuelta lists into one complete cycle after removing duplicated handoff 1311 and repeated cycle-boundary 091. The stored cycle closes from 344 to 091 exactly once.
Combines the current R12 Ida and Vuelta lists into one complete cycle after removing duplicated handoff 1311 and repeated cycle-boundary 091. The stored cycle closes from 236 to 091 exactly once.

Uses the current ordered textual R12 source for the active coastal circulation, including Gran Via and Bahia codes 1257, 1258, 1280-1283, 1320 and 1321. The supplied diagram is retained as historical/visual evidence and does not override the current order silently.

Uses municipal stop code as stable identity. Accepted airport/coastal objects are copied complete-object exact. New codes receive deterministic elche-stop-/elche-place- identities and singleton StopPlaces.
Serializes StopPlaces and StopNodes in ascending numeric municipal-code order and creates deterministic lexicographically ordered ZIP entries with fixed metadata.
Writes final scenario assets, computes asset SHA-256 values and aggregate contentHash, and appends exactly one catalog descriptor.

warnings: Runtime StopNode sourceReferences remain empty for new nodes because that field accepts only genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position evidence. Municipal codes, route pages, diagrams and map coordinates remain provenance evidence.

R12 current ordered source differs from the supplied older diagram in Arenales del Sol. The current source includes the Gran Via/Bahia circulation; the diagram is not used to remove these current stops.
Shared L'Altet and Arenales identities established in elche-radial-airport-v1 are copied exactly wherever municipal codes match; they are not recreated from newer coordinates or labels.
Different municipal codes remain distinct StopNodes and singleton StopPlaces even when names, sides of road or coordinates are close. No name-, proximity- or exact-coordinate merge was performed.
closesLoop creates exactly one final-to-first edge per pattern. Internal loops remain possible only when produced by explicit consecutive entries or non-consecutive revisits.
Physical StopPlace creation does not create route edges, reverse patterns, cross-pattern graph edges or vehicle lifecycle edges.
All earlier scenario files, including the grandfathered Torrevieja sourceReferences issue, are preserved byte-for-byte and are not corrected in this build.
